subject: BrightCart - Marketplace private offer & unit price mapping (post-call)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@brightcart.com>, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: BrightCart - Marketplace private offer & unit price mapping (post-call)

Thanks again for the call this morning, Daniel — great to meet. Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned:

- Summary: BrightCart is evaluating Redwood for inference across two primary workloads: customer support (chat, short context, high qps) and product recommendations (batch embedding generation).
- Volumes discussed: ~2B tokens/mo for support (peak spikes), ~1.5B tokens/mo for embedding generation (monthly batch windows).
- Budget guidance you shared: target $/1M tokens in the range of $450–$700 (total cost budget, inclusive of marketplace fees).
- Marketplace route: you prefer an AWS Private Offer (MPA) to consolidate procurement. You also want unit price mapping so finance can compare Redwood MPA vs. direct billed pricing.

Action items we agreed:
1) I’ll send a proposed unit-price mapping (per-1M tokens) that shows how Redwood hosted API list maps to an AWS private-offer unit price, including an example of egress/marketplace fee assumptions.
2) You’ll paste any procurement constraints or target contract term (12/24 months) and confirm whether BrightCart requires PO or DocuSign flow.
3) Aditya will join procurement/marketplace conversations to coordinate the MPA submission with AWS.

Questions for you: can you confirm the 2B / 1.5B monthly split is representative for the first 6 months (yes/no)? Also confirm whether BrightCart expects a single blended unit price or separate unit prices by workload (support vs. embeddings).

I’ve attached a simple mapping template that shows how we translate Redwood list prices to an MPA unit price (assumes marketplace fee = 12%). If you’re comfortable with the assumptions we can lock a target $/1M tokens and I’ll put together the formal MPA proposal and term sheet.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Deals
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: brightcart_token_pricing_map.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet)]

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@brightcart.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@brightcart.com
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 13:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightCart - Marketplace private offer & unit price mapping (post-call)

Thanks Marissa — appreciated the summary. A few clarifications from our side:

- Volumes: yes, 2B tokens/mo for support and 1.5B tokens/mo for embeddings is a reasonable 6-month ramp estimate. There will be seasonal spikes (Q4 holiday period) but we can handle that with burst terms in the MPA if needed.
- Contract term: pref 12 months with an option to extend; finance prefers PO flow but can accept DocuSign for initial pilots.
- Pricing structure: finance is asking for a single blended unit price for headcount simplicity (they don’t want to track multiple SKUs across teams). If possible give a blended $/1M tokens scenario plus a split view so we can see sensitivity.

Target budget: the $450–$700 per 1M tokens range is correct as a target. To land the deal they’re hoping for ~ $480–$520 blended for year 1 if we can get a firm MPA structure.

Procurement note: procurement@brightcart.com handles the MPA submission; they’ll need the draft MPA terms and the AWS pricing sheet (spreadsheet with unit price lines) to start the private-offer request.

I’ll review the attached mapping and get back with any redlines by EOD tomorrow.

—Daniel
Head of Cloud Ops
BrightCart

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@brightcart.com>, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com, procurement@brightcart.com
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightCart - Marketplace private offer & unit price mapping (post-call)

Thanks Daniel — really helpful. Attached is the filled pricing-mapping template with three scenarios: List vs. 12% marketplace fee mapping, blended example (weighted by your volume split), and a target-price scenario to reach $500/1M tokens blended.

Highlights:
- List mapping: Redwood hosted list price (generation) = $620 / 1M tokens -> MPA unit price (after 12% marketplace fee and small rounding) = $698 / 1M tokens.
- Blended mapping (2B support / 1.5B embeddings): blended list = $590 -> MPA blended = $668 / 1M tokens.
- Target scenario: to arrive at BrightCart target ~$500/1M blended we recommend a 15% volume discount off the blended list price plus a marketplace fee credit line in the MPA term (we include the math in the spreadsheet).

Attachments: brightcart_token_pricing_map.xlsx, brightcart_mpa_terms.pdf

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa/Aditya to finalize the MPA pricing sheet and share with procurement so they can open the private-offer request with AWS.
2) Procurement to confirm preferred contract flow (PO vs DocuSign) and provide vendor contact at AWS if they have one.
3) If BrightCart is comfortable with the target scenario, we’ll prepare a draft MPA and an internal price-protect clause for the pilot period.

If you want, we can schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow for legal/procurement to walk through the spreadsheet live. Aditya — can you join that call?

Best,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Deals
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: brightcart_token_pricing_map.xlsx, brightcart_mpa_terms.pdf]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@brightcart.com>
Cc: rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com, procurement@brightcart.com
Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightCart - Marketplace private offer & unit price mapping (post-call)

I’ll join tomorrow’s sync — putting it on the calendar for 11:00 PT. For the MPA submission, I’ll prepare two variants of the AWS pricing sheet: (A) blended unit price lines as requested by BrightCart, and (B) split SKU lines (support vs embeddings) so we have fallback if AWS requires per-SKU mapping.

I’ve also added a note to include a marketplace-fee credit clause in the MPA (60-day review window) to protect BrightCart during ramp. Rafael — can you confirm we’re ok to include the 15% volume discount in the initial pilot term?

Thanks,
Aditya
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
